title: Maintained-System Credit for HVAC Members on Unclosed Listings
content:
**Member benefit note.** A seller whose home's heating and cooling are kept under Bridgewell HVAC Maintenance Agreements receives a maintained-system credit on a failed sale of a Real Estate Service Contracts listing order. The credit is a share of the heating, cooling and ductwork benefit authorized on the order less the reversals of such authorizations, rounded to the cent, and it is subtracted from the failed-sale charge before the charge is floored at zero.

| Seller's HVAC Maintenance Agreements position | Completed tune-up visits in the twelve months before the billing date | Share of the net heating, cooling and ductwork benefit |
|---|---|---|
| an active Bridgewell HVAC maintenance agreement on the same property address | 2 or more | 20% |
| an active Bridgewell HVAC maintenance agreement on the same property address | 1 (at least one but fewer than 2) | 10% |
| no active agreement on the same property address | any | no maintained-system credit |
| an active agreement on the same property address | none | no maintained-system credit |

The completed tune-up visits are those recorded under the seller's maintenance agreements in the twelve months before the billing date.

## Records read

From the HVAC Maintenance Agreements records: the seller's agreement, its property address and status, and its tune-up visit entries with their visit status and date. From the order's claim records: the benefit authorizations and reversals for the heating system, cooling system and ductwork.

## Worked example (hypothetical)

Heating system authorizations of $1500.00 on the order and one reversal of $250.00 on the heating system: net heating, cooling and ductwork benefit $1250.00. With an active agreement at the same address and 2 completed tune-ups in the last twelve months: 20% of $1250.00, a credit of **$250.00**. With 1 completed tune-up: 10%, a credit of **$125.00**. With the agreement registered at a different address: no credit.
